'''Kam Wendan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. In [[3631 BBY]], he was visiting the [[Old World]], where he was betting on the pit fights in the Arena with [[Mona Gale]]. After a six consecutive loss, Wendan witnessed the dialogue between Mona and a renegade member of the [[Knights of Zakuul]] [[Senya Tirall]]. During that time, a broadcast by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]] identified Tirall and [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] as dangerous fugitives, prompting Gale to provide them information and Wendan to smile and wave his hand peacefully.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kam Wendan appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 7: The Lady of Sorrows'''. He is voiced by [[Nolan North]].
